claim: The regulatory saga formally concluded when the FTC published a final rule in the Federal Register on February 12, 2026, officially removing the Non-Compete Rule from the Code of Federal Regulations, specifically 16 CFR part 910
evidence: On September 5, 2025, the Commission voted 3-1 to dismiss its appeals in Ryan, LLC v. FTC, No. 24-10951 (5th Cir.), and Properties of the Villages v. FTC, No. 24-13102 (11th Cir.) and accede to the vacatur of the Non-Compete Rule.[23] With the Commission having now acceded to vacatur, this final rule removes the Non-Compete Rule codified at 16 CFR part 910 from the Code of Federal Regulations (“CFR”).
